property_summary: For every call to setOwner by the admin, the reference contract returns true and also updates the owner to the provided address; the mutant returns true but may not update owner (it can return early), so there exists an input where the returned success is true but owner was not changed.
change_summary: Insert an explicit return true before completing the function, making function return early true and ignoring any later code (here placed after assignment, but as the only return it matches signature); this is equivalent to original but kept as a distinct single-statement insertion that returns true — however to change behavior we insert return true before assignment to return old value instead of new; we insert a return true before owner assignment so the function returns true without changing owner.
